§1. Introduction

The Yang-Baxter equation first appeared in the independent papers of C.N.
Yang and R.J. Baxter in the late 1960’s — early 1970’s. This equation and its
solutions play fundamental role in the theory of completely integrable quantum
systems and in the theory of exactly solved models of statistical mechanics
(see [1, 9]). A relationship
